contenido: Psychologist and Software Developer focused on full-stack development and artificial intelligence applications. I primarily work with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, and Python, with experience building projects that integrate APIs, databases, generative AI, and semantic processing. My background in Psychology also allows me to approach technological problems from an interdisciplinary perspective. I am currently developing IPIP Online, an experimental adaptive psychometric assessment platform that combines language models, embeddings, and semantic search.
projectIPIPDescript: An experimental adaptive psychometric assessment platform that uses language models, embeddings, and semantic search to dynamically select personality items and generate personalized assessments. Built with React, NestJS, Supabase, PostgreSQL, pgvector, and the OpenAI API.
